claim_boundary: This is a converted braid payload for the Yasui Figure 3 a=1 presentation. It is not yet a comparison with the standard CP2#2CPbar presentation.

kirby_calibration.reason: The raw oriented drawing convention gives A-B=-2 and a non-unimodular 3x3 linking matrix.  Yasui Figure 3 a=1 is a no-1/no-3-handle presentation of CP2#2CPbar, so the evaluator payload is calibrated to the target_intersection_matrix by switching all A-B crossings.

local_piece_programs.description: Evaluator-ready braid-closure local-piece program for Yasui Figure 3 a=1, with component order matching omega_label_order.
